decision.reason: [ev-13b804c336de] is just a one-line changelog commit title. It says the hydrator now triggers refreshes by annotation instead of a work queue. It does not say which environments are exposed, for example whether the source hydrator feature has to be enabled, or what an exposed operator would see if they do nothing (the bug being fixed, any visible annotation, any action needed). The text of PR #22016 or the hydrator docs would be needed to settle applicability and consequence.
